constant-force response agrees with independent RK4 over k0/small/normal/high drag

evidence.oracle: RK4 differential equations, force-cell aligned, h<=.0002 and k*h<=.25

checks.name: correlated seeded schedules agree with independent ODE and preserve finite mean-envelope area
k→0, subnormal k*dt, short ages and drag cache eviction remain stable
right-hand force selection and cutoff retain continuous pose and inertial velocity
future force cells cannot affect any earlier response or acceleration
motor contribution superposes with actual ballistic/wind/gravity pose and independent full ODE

evidence.scope: Detached composition with actual base sampler; production sampleBody has no thrust import yet

checks.name: frame rotation and keyed seeds are deterministic without Math.random or query-order dependence
declared heading-step and impulse-kernel motion bounds enclose all sampled trajectories

evidence.warning: Heading step is not a continuous angular-rate bound; numerical enclosures use stated tolerance

checks.name: invalid data, accessors, spoof profiles and unbounded clocks are rejected without getter execution

limits: New pure helper only; no scene/sampleBody/smoke/framing/optical pipeline integration or native GPU run.
Authored effective acceleration/drag; no calibrated thrust, mass, fuel, photometry, continuous attitude or real bee fit.
Prefix tables use known immutable force cells only; queried response never uses a cell portion after the requested relative age.
Piecewise-held acceleration may jump; position/velocity remain continuous. Independent ODE is a numerical oracle with finite tolerance.
